title: Habit 4: Think Win/Win
coreMove: Think Win/Win by protecting both legitimate wins; courage without consideration dominates, while consideration without courage quietly surrenders.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a reward board may pit employees against service
one shared rig may create resentment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use No Deal instead of forced compromise
seek a solution that preserves dignity and fairness

exampleSpecs.stakes: a client demand may damage staff and reputation
popular classes may create internal rivalry
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: build a shared win into the schedule

exampleSpecs.stakes: a refund request may break policy or trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: hold a clear No Deal without contempt
